title: Programme de refondation de l'école tchadienne (PRET) — Document du programme
why_not: Describes the SIGE as the annual census keyed into StatEduc2 and its yearbooks; names no record per learner. Its one school-level fact, the 40-school N'Djamena trial, is stated with more detail and a date in lead 2. It does state, for the census: a 2014 SIGE strategy due for revision, no domestic budget line for statistics, and digital collection by mobile application still to be done.
